description: Unit test class for the AuthenticationChain in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.gateway.security.authentication package, testing authentication provider selection, result aggregation, and failure handling.

classes.name: AuthenticationChainTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of AuthenticationChain including provider selection, failure aggregation, and edge cases.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test fixtures such as the known authorization context and message dispatcher.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test-specific variables prior to each test execution.

methods.name: getInstanceThrowsIllegalArgumentExceptionWhenProviderListIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that getInstance method throws an exception when provided with an empty list of authentication providers.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Tests the authentication process, verifying provider applicability, correct result returns, and proper handling of failures.

methods.name: authenticateReturnsFirstAuthenticationResultIfMultipleProvidersAreApplicable
methods.description: Checks that the first applicable provider's result is returned when multiple providers apply.

methods.name: authenticateReturnsIllegalStateAuthenticationResultIfCalledWhenNoProvidersAreApplicable
methods.description: Verifies that an illegal state result is produced if no providers are applicable.

methods.name: authenticateReturnsFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Checks behavior when a provider fails authentication.

methods.name: authenticateReturnsSuccessfulAuthenticationResultIfOneProviderSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies that a successful authentication result is returned if any applicable provider succeeds.

methods.name: authenticateAggregatesFailureDescriptionsIfMultipleProvidersFail
methods.description: Tests that failure messages are combined appropriately when multiple providers fail.

methods.name: mockRequestContextForAuthenticate
methods.description: Helper method to mock RequestContext with an HttpRequest for authentication testing.

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Helper method to create a completed CompletableFuture with a given value.
